themes.name: azure
themes.title: Azure
themes.description: The desktop's navy frame and Azure blue, with tinted tables and a gradient cover.
themes.coverArt:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="210mm" height="297mm" viewBox="0 0 2100 2970">
  <!-- Cover artwork for A4 portrait. Double-brace palette names are filled from the
       resolved theme palette, so the artwork follows the branding colours. -->
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sweep" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#102239"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#1a4169"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#0668cc"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="0.82" cy="0.12" r="0.62">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0078d4" stop-opacity="0.42"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#0078d4" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="floor" cx="0.1" cy="1" r="0.7">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#102239" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#102239" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="2100" height="2970" fill="url(#sweep)"/>
  <rect width="2100" height="2970" fill="url(#glow)"/>
  <rect width="2100" height="2970" fill="url(#floor)"/>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity="0.07" stroke-width="3">
    <circle cx="1780" cy="420" r="420"/>
    <circle cx="1780" cy="420" r="640"/>
    <circle cx="1780" cy="420" r="880"/>
    <circle cx="1780" cy="420" r="1140"/>
    <circle cx="1780" cy="420" r="1420"/>
  </g>
  <rect y="2940" width="2100" height="30" fill="#0078d4" fill-opacity="0.85"/>
</svg>

themes.name: field-report
themes.title: Field Report
themes.description: Paper, ink, serif hierarchy and evidence-led colour.
themes.coverArt:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="210mm" height="297mm" viewBox="0 0 2100 2970">
  <!-- Cover artwork for A4 portrait: a warm paper gradient that keeps the
       editorial cover's ink type legible. Double-brace palette names are
       filled from the resolved theme palette. -->
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="paper" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.35" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#faf8f4"/>
      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#f3efe7"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#d8d2c6"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="light" cx="0.5" cy="0.36" r="0.55">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#faf8f4" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#faf8f4" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="brand" cx="1" cy="1" r="0.6">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0078d4" stop-opacity="0.12"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#0078d4" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="2100" height="2970" fill="url(#paper)"/>
  <rect width="2100" height="2970" fill="url(#brand)"/>
  <rect width="2100" height="2970" fill="url(#light)"/>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#1c2430" stroke-opacity="0.05" stroke-width="3">
    <circle cx="2100" cy="2970" r="700"/>
    <circle cx="2100" cy="2970" r="1000"/>
    <circle cx="2100" cy="2970" r="1320"/>
    <circle cx="2100" cy="2970" r="1660"/>
  </g>
  <rect y="2950" width="2100" height="20" fill="#1c2430"/>
</svg>
